title: Usnic Acid Derivatives as Inhibitors of Mycobacterium tuberculosis Uracil-DNA Glycosylase.
authors: Filimonov, Aleksandr S; Zateeva, Maria V; Mechetin, Grigory V; Luzina, Olga A; Eurtivong, Chatchakorn; Sari, Suat; Endutkin, Anton V; Reynisson, Johannes; Volcho, Konstantin P; Salakhutdinov, Nariman F; Zharkov, Dmitry O
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟筛选和分子对接研究地衣酸衍生物抑制结核分枝杆菌尿嘧啶-DNA糖基化酶，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作（酶-DNA结合界面）且含结构建模方法，但对象非TF-DNA体系，故评5分。
abstract: Tuberculosis (TB) remains a global health issue exacerbated by spreading drug resistance and lengthy treatment regimens. Targeting bacterial DNA-repair pathways, particularly those counteracting host-generated genotoxic stress, represents a promising strategy to sensitize Mycobacterium tuberculosis to existing antibiotics. Through structure-based virtual screening of a compound library, we identified novel small-molecule inhibitors of M. tuberculosis uracil-DNA glycosylase (MtbUng), an enzyme essential for the repair of DNA damage inflicted by macrophage-produced reactive nitrogen species. Experimental validation revealed that four derivatives of usnic acid, a lichen-derived metabolite, significantly inhibited MtbUng activity, with the most potent compound, OL10-88-1, exhibiting IC(50) 26 +/- 7 microM. Molecular docking suggests that OL10-88-1 inhibits MtbUng by occupying both the active site and the DNA-binding groove, thereby disrupting multiple steps of uracil recognition. The compounds also showed variable inhibitory activity against uracil-DNA glycosylases from Escherichia coli, humans, and vaccinia virus. Our findings establish that the compound could potentially be used in combination therapies to enhance the efficacy of current anti-TB drugs by exploiting the vulnerability of DNA-repair-deficient mycobacteria.
abstract_zh: 结核病（TB）仍是全球性健康问题，耐药性扩散和漫长治疗疗程加剧了这一挑战。靶向细菌DNA修复通路，特别是对抗宿主产生的基因毒性应激的通路，代表了一种有前景的策略，可使结核分枝杆菌对现有抗生素更敏感。通过对化合物库进行基于结构的虚拟筛选，我们鉴定了结核分枝杆菌尿嘧啶-DNA糖基化酶（MtbUng）的新型小分子抑制剂，该酶对修复巨噬细胞产生活性氮物种造成的DNA损伤至关重要。实验验证显示，地衣来源代谢物松萝酸的四种衍生物显著抑制MtbUng活性，其中效力最强的化合物OL10-88-1表现出IC(50) 26 ± 7微摩尔。分子对接提示，OL10-88-1通过占据活性位点和DNA结合沟槽来抑制MtbUng，从而破坏尿嘧啶识别的多个步骤。这些化合物对来自大肠杆菌、人类和痘苗病毒的尿嘧啶-DNA糖基化酶也表现出可变的抑制活性。我们的发现表明，该化合物可能用于联合疗法，通过利用DNA修复缺陷分枝杆菌的脆弱性，增强现有抗结核药物的疗效。
